verdict.rationale: Feitian's MultiPass key explicitly lists NFC as one of its three interfaces and is described as compatible with Android/iOS platforms, and another product is marketed as a 'USB + NFC security key for login on PC and Android,' supporting the core claim that NFC tap-based auth on mobile is possible. However, there is no dedicated documentation, setup guide, or hands-on account specifically covering NFC use in mobile browsers/apps (unlike the detailed guides for BLE pairing, Windows Hello, or OpenSSH), so the mobile-browser NFC experience is only inferred from spec sheets. Missing for 10: dedicated mobile-browser/app NFC setup guide, independent hands-on confirmation of NFC tap authentication on phones, and details on iOS NFC support specifically (only Android is explicitly named).
